purpose: Teach: 女児/インサイダー/安保理/郵政省/運輸省/建設省/日本共産党/中共

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、女児虐待防止策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on child abuse prevention, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, conversational confirmation. Light lift on the name. Genuine curiosity underneath. Measured pace—teacher checking in, not testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、企業のインサイダー取引を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote on corporate insider trading.
lines.style: Clear, straightforward correction. No defensiveness. Respectful but confident in her own choice. Slightly faster than the teacher, matching her earnestness with directness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国連安保理の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ah, and the UN Security Council's postwar history was your focus, then.
lines.style: Gentle recalibration. Slight curiosity in the voice—she's listening now, tracking what Sakura is actually saying. Warm acceptance of the correction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、旧郵政省の民営化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I wrote about the privatization of Japan's postal service.
lines.style: Patient but clear. Not frustrated by the misunderstanding. Measured, matter-of-fact tone. She's stating fact, not correcting harshly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 旧運輸省の組織改編史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The Ministry of Transport's reorganization—that's what you chose for your paper.
lines.style: Still tracking, still gentle. A pause between thoughts, like she's mentally catching up and appreciating the scope. Thoughtful tone, slightly slower.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、旧建設省の公共事業史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I focused on the history of public works under the former Construction Ministry.
lines.style: Calm but clear. Not annoyed at the continued misunderstanding, just plainly stating what she actually did. Steady rhythm. Matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 日本共産党の戦後史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The Japanese Communist Party's postwar trajectory—that was your choice.
lines.style: One more gentle confirmation, with a hint of 'let me see if I have this right.' Reflective, slower pace. Warm but slightly bemused.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中共政府と日本外交を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I actually wrote about China's government and Japan's diplomatic relations with them.
lines.style: Final, clear correction. A subtle finality underneath—she's been patient through all of these, but this is the last one she's correcting. Voice stays warm but carries gentle resolve. Close.
